purpose: Two-node inference-only V3/V4 CUDA Graph comparison at locked 1620 MHz

measurement.timing: CUDA event around complete graph replay batch
measurement.evidence: Reversed-order independent-process sessions; not per-iteration switching in one process
measurement.reported_p50: Per sample rank maximum, pool 40 samples from both sessions of each version, select sorted index 19 (lower p50)
measurement.rank_sync: NCCL rank barrier outside each timed sample
measurement.pool_capacity: Separate pool for each case, token capacity matches the case
measurement.excluded: 1980 MHz unlocked preliminary runs and 2026-09-22 historical timings

v3.selection: Current V3 inference fallback with previously validated multi-node Qwen profile; no new E64/K4 autotune

v4.selection: Final static multi-node implementation with 2026-09-22 frozen profile

conclusion: V4 improves decode but regresses 8192/20480-token prefill against this V3 profile. This is an implementation-plus-configuration comparison, not isolated scheduler attribution.

before.evidence: C: adjacent-build bundle; third barrier and context sizing changed together

historical_milestone_not_part_of_locked_.attribution: C: removal of third network barrier plus active/allocated context reduction; no isolated attribution
